description:
Find the Spanish company a trademark or trading name is linked to, in the
Spanish patent office's (OEPM) trademark and commercial-name records we
hold (the archive starts in 1987).

Use it when the user names a brand; for a company's own name use
search_companies, for a known company's brands use company_brands.

Returns JSON {found, brand, matches: [{brand, kind, company_slug,
company_name, company_status, file}], truncated, source, note}. kind
commercial_name identifies a business; trademark distinguishes goods or
services (NESCAFÉ is not another name for Nestlé): say which kind a hit
is. Links come from holder-name matching (the office publishes no tax
IDs); ambiguous holders stay unlinked: present a hit as a name match,
not confirmed ownership. found false is not proof the brand is unused.
On a hit, use company_history with the slug.

Read-only; one request per call. Needs the basic plan or higher: send your
API key in the X-API-Key header (https://bormeapi.com/account).

brand.description: Brand or trading name, or part of it, at least 3 letters or digits after punctuation is removed, case-insensitive, e.g. "ZARA".
brand.title: Brand

name: brand_owner
title: Find a brand's company
